title: Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems
title_zh: 构建智能体式机器学习工程系统的洞察体系

paragraphs.en: Agentic machine learning engineering (MLE) is an emerging AI4SE application, targeting complex machine learning tasks and taking a step toward the recursive self-improvement of AI systems. Recent agentic MLE systems highlight the importance of collecting and leveraging insights from closely-related MLE tasks: some systems condition code generation on expert domain knowledge, which is implicitly curated from peer MLE tasks; some systems have a loop of solving an MLE task, gathering validation feedback, and refining their prompts, skills, or memory to benefit future tasks. However, collecting and injecting insights is ad hoc, and existing evaluations do not control the sources of insights, leaving data leakage a threat to validity.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体机器学习工程（MLE）是一项新兴的 AI4SE 应用，旨在应对复杂的机器学习任务，并推动人工智能系统向递归自我改进的方向发展。 近期的智能体 MLE 系统凸显了收集并利用密切相关 MLE 任务的洞察的重要性：一些系统会根据专家领域知识来调整代码生成，而这些知识是隐式地从同类 MLE 任务中整理而来的；另一些系统则通过解决 MLE 任务、收集验证反馈，并优化提示、技能或记忆，从而为后续任务带来改进。 然而，洞察的收集与注入过程缺乏系统性，且现有评估并未控制洞察的来源，导致数据泄露可能对有效性构成威胁。

paragraphs.en: To close these gaps, we systematically study how insights assembled from closely-related MLE tasks affect an agentic MLE system, and how their effect depends on the type of insights and the way they are injected. We first collect a new benchmark, MLE-InsightBench , consisting of 160 Kaggle competitions clustered into 12 domains. MLE-InsightBench is designed to keep target task information out of the insights: one competition from each domain is held out as a target task, and only the remaining 148 competitions, none of which can have been influenced by the target tasks (e.g., as a later edition of the same series or by reusing their solutions), serve as source competitions. We then design and implement an insight assembly agent, MLE-InsightForge , that explores the source competitions, their top human-written solutions, and writeups, and assembles them into three types of insights: 12 domain insights (summarizing domain-level best practices), 148 competition insights (describing competition-level winning solutions), and 16 improvement insights (detailing generic debugging and improvement strategies). The extracted insights can be injected into an agentic MLE system as skills, which the agent reads selectively on demand, or as a playbook placed upfront in its initial context. In our evaluation, the extracted insights improve the normalized private-test score of an agentic MLE system by 123.9% over the baseline without insights. Further controlled experiments show that: the three types of insights are complementary, the better injection mode (skill vs. playbook) varies across tasks, with skills being more cost-effective overall, and the improvements from insights generalize across backend LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了填补这些差距，我们系统性地研究了从密切相关的最优解学习（MLE）任务中整合而来的见解如何影响智能体式 MLE 系统，以及这种影响如何取决于见解的类型及其注入方式。 我们首先收集了一个新的基准数据集 MLE-InsightBench，它由 160 个 Kaggle 竞赛组成，这些竞赛被聚类到 12 个领域。 MLE-InsightBench 的设计旨在避免将目标任务的信息包含在见解中：每个领域的一个竞赛被保留作为目标任务，而其余的 148 个竞赛仅用作源竞赛，其中没有任何一个可能受到目标任务的影响（例如，作为同一系列的后续版本或重复使用其解决方案）。 接着，我们设计并实现了一个见解整合智能体 MLE-InsightForge，它能探索源竞赛、这些竞赛中人类撰写的最佳解决方案及说明，并将它们整合为三种类型的见解：12 个领域见解（总结领域级的最佳实践）、148 个竞赛见解（描述竞赛级的获胜方案）以及 16 个改进见解（详细说明通用的调试与改进策略）。 提取出的见解可以作为技能注入到智能体式 MLE 系统中，由智能体按需选择性读取；也可以作为策略手册预先置于其初始上下文中。 在我们的评估中，提取出的见解使智能体式 MLE 系统的归一化私有测试分数相比无见解的基线提升了 123.9%。 进一步的受控实验表明：三种类型的见解具有互补性，更优的注入模式（技能 vs. 策略手册）因任务而异，但总体而言技能更具成本效益，且由见解带来的改进能够泛化到不同的后端大型语言模型上。

paragraphs.en: Machine learning engineering (MLE) is the end-to-end work of turning a dataset and a modeling objective into an executable machine learning (ML) solution, including data inspection, model selection, validation design, debugging, and compute allocation. ML solutions are typically written in Python, as Jupyter notebooks or scripts ( Pimentel et al., 2019 ; Grotov et al., 2022 ) , and the SE community has studied them as software artifacts with distinct engineering challenges, such as data management, code quality, and reproducibility ( Amershi et al., 2019 ; Pimentel et al., 2019 ; Mostafavi Ghahfarokhi et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . This makes ML solutions a natural target of LLM-based coding agents, but also a challenging one. Existing code generation benchmarks, including those for data science code, check a generated function, notebook cell, or patch against tests or reference outputs ( Lai et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2023 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . An ML solution, in contrast, has no test oracle: its quality is a metric value on unseen data, which can only be estimated by executing long-running training code and improved by repeatedly revising the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 机器学习工程（MLE）是将数据集和建模目标转化为可执行的机器学习（ML）解决方案的全流程工作，包括数据检查、模型选择、验证设计、调试和计算资源分配。 机器学习解决方案通常用 Python 编写，以 Jupyter Notebook 或脚本的形式呈现（Pimentel 等，2019；Grotov 等，2022），软件工程（SE）领域已将其视为具有独特工程挑战的软件产物进行研究，例如数据管理、代码质量和可重复性（Amershi 等，2019；Pimentel 等，2019；Mostafavi Ghahfarokhi 等，2024；Jin 等，2026）。 这使得机器学习解决方案成为基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编码的自然目标，但也带来了挑战。 现有的代码生成基准测试，包括数据科学代码相关的测试，都会将生成的函数、Notebook 单元格或代码片段与测试用例或参考输出进行比对（Lai 等，2023；Yin 等，2023；Jimenez 等，2024）。 相比之下，机器学习解决方案没有测试判据：其质量取决于在未见数据上的指标值，而该值只能通过执行长时间运行的训练代码来估计，并通过反复修改解决方案来改进。

paragraphs.en: Agentic MLE is an emerging application of coding agents in which LLMs perform this work by iteratively writing, executing, and refining code ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Agentic MLE systems target complex ML tasks, such as Kaggle competitions, and are a step toward the recursive self-improvement of AI systems, since a system that can engineer ML solutions can, in principle, contribute to building better AI systems ( Chan et al., 2025 ) . Evolution has been rapid: on MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , the fraction of competitions in which the best system earns a medal grew from 17% in late 2024 to over 60% in early 2026.

Each system collects insights from different sources (web search, curated knowledge bases, or its own past runs), represents them differently, and injects them into the agent’s context in its own way. The ablation studies in these work typically remove the entire insight source, e.g., the knowledge base or the cache of prior wisdom ( Du et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , which shows that insights help as a whole but leaves open which types of insights contribute and how they should be injected.

paragraphs.en: Moreover, existing evaluations of these systems do not control for the sources of insights, which leaves data leakage as a threat to validity: the sources are chosen by each system rather than fixed by the benchmark, so whether they exclude the target tasks is left to each system and rarely verifiable. paragraphs.en: To bridge these gaps, we systematically study how insights assembled from closely-related MLE tasks affect agentic MLE systems, and how their effect depends on the type of insights and the way they are injected. paragraphs.en: On the 12 target tasks, the assembled insights improve the normalized score of an agentic MLE system by 123.9% over the baseline without insights, improving every task (significantly on 11) when injected as skills; on an energy forecasting task, every run with insights beats the best run without them, although none of its peer competitions involves energy. The improvements from insights generalize across backend LLMs, including a stronger proprietary LLM ( GPT-6.1-Sol ). paragraphs.en: An MLE task asks for an executable ML solution rather than only a fitted model: it involves understanding the data and the metric, designing a validation protocol, implementing preprocessing and training, diagnosing failures, and producing an artifact that satisfies a submission contract. These decisions are coupled: for example, the validation split must reflect the deployment distribution, while model and feature choices must respect runtime and memory limits. Competitions on Kaggle ( Kaggle, 2026a ) expose MLE tasks through a common interface consisting of a task description, datasets, an evaluation metric, a compute environment, and a submission format. Figure 2 shows an example Kaggle competition, Jigsaw – Agile Community Rules Classification ( Sorensen et al., 2025a ) , which asks whether a Reddit comment violates a given rule, including rules unseen in training, together with a solution developed by an agentic MLE system. The solution prepares features from the training data, validates the model by holding out one rule at a time to mimic the unseen rules, retrains on all training data, and writes the predictions for the test data in the submission format.

paragraphs.en: MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) turns 75 Kaggle competitions into an offline benchmark: each competition’s training data is split into new training and private-test sets, and a submission is graded against the private-test labels and compared with the human leaderboard. paragraphs.en: An agentic MLE system combines an LLM with tools for inspecting data, editing code, executing experiments, and observing validation feedback, typically following the ReAct pattern of interleaved reasoning and tool use ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Beyond a single linear trajectory, most recent systems search over candidate solutions. AIDE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) maintains a tree of solutions that are drafted, debugged, and improved; ML-Master ( Liu et al., 2025 ) explores such trees with Monte Carlo tree search, and AIRA-dojo ( Toledo et al., 2025 ) compares search policies and operators over them; and FM Agent and LoongFlow ( Li et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) evolve populations of solutions. Within a task, these systems accumulate the code, scores, and reflections produced by earlier candidates to guide later ones.

paragraphs.en: External knowledge: Insights are curated from external sources, such as solutions of similar MLE tasks on open-source repositories and competition platforms, API documentations, and forum discussions. Some techniques retrieve them on the fly, typically via web search (e.g., MLE-STAR ( Nam et al., 2025 ) and MARS ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ); others build a knowledge base offline which is used for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) at solving time (e.g., DS-Agent ( Guo et al., 2024 ) , MLEvolve ( Du et al., 2026 ) , AutoMLGen ( Du et al., 2025 ) , KAPSO ( Nadafian et al., 2026 ) , AIBuildAI-2 ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and FM Agent ( Li et al., 2025 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 外部知识：见解来自外部来源的整理，例如开源仓库和竞赛平台上类似 MLE 任务的解决方案、API 文档以及论坛讨论。 一些技术会即时检索这些知识，通常通过网页搜索（例如 MLE-STAR（Nam 等人，2025）和 MARS（Chen 等人，2026））；另一些技术则离线构建知识库，并在求解时用于检索增强生成（RAG）（例如 DS-Agent（Guo 等人，2024）、MLEvolve（Du 等人，2026）、AutoMLGen（Du 等人，2025）、KAPSO（Nadafian 等人，2026）、AIBuildAI-2（Zhang 等人，2026b）以及 FM Agent（Li 等人，2025））。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of their source, insights reach the agent as text in its context, and systems differ in when this happens. In the skill mode ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , only compact metadata of each insight (a name and a description) is placed in the context, and the agent loads the full text on demand, a design known as progressive disclosure. In the playbook mode ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , the insights are placed directly in the initial context as a playbook; unlike a human-written prompt, a playbook is generated and maintained by LLM agents. Skills save context but depend on the agent retrieving the right insight, whereas playbooks make every insight available but consume context even for irrelevant insights.
paragraphs.zh: 无论其来源如何，洞察都会以文本形式作为上下文的一部分传递给智能体，而不同系统在这一过程发生的时间上存在差异。 在技能模式（Anthropic, 2025）中，只有每个洞察的简洁元数据（名称和描述）会被放入上下文，而智能体则按需加载完整文本；这种设计被称为渐进式披露。 在剧本模式（Zhang et al., 2026a）中，洞察会直接作为剧本的一部分置于初始上下文中；与人类编写的提示不同，剧本是由大型语言模型智能体生成和管理的。 技能模式可以节省上下文空间，但依赖于智能体能否检索到正确的洞察；而剧本模式则让所有洞察均可用，但即使无关的洞察也会占用上下文空间。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation of an agentic MLE system suffers from data leakage when the system has access, during solving, to information about the target task that would not be available when solving a genuinely new task, most notably the task’s own winning solutions. This differs from train–test leakage in a generated solution, which some systems check ( Nam et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ) , and from contamination of the backend LLM’s pre-training data, which several papers acknowledge as a limitation ( Nam et al., 2025 ; Toledo et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体式 MLE 系统在求解过程中能够访问目标任务的某些信息（这些信息在解决真正的新任务时是无法获取的，尤其是该任务本身的获胜解决方案）时，对该系统的评估就会受到数据泄露的影响。 这与生成解决方案中的训练-测试数据泄露不同（一些系统会对此进行检查（Nam et al., 2025；Du et al., 2026）），也与后端 LLM 的预训练数据污染不同（多篇论文已承认这是其局限性之一（Nam et al., 2025；Toledo et al., 2025））。

paragraphs.en: Insights are a direct channel for such leakage, because their sources are usually the same public competition materials from which target tasks are drawn. Web search at solving time is not reported to be restricted to materials of other tasks ( Nam et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , and knowledge bases built from competition platforms typically do not report whether the target tasks were excluded ( Du et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2025 ) . Some work did exclude the target tasks by competition name ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , which does not cover later editions of the same competition series. For example, MLE-InsightBench contains two AI Mathematical Olympiad: Progress Prize 1 ( XTX Investments, 2024 ) and Progress Prize 2 ( Frieder et al., 2024 ) ; if the first were a target task, excluding it by name would still admit the second, whose description states that it builds upon the first and one of whose gold-medal notebooks reuses code from the winning solution of the first.

paragraphs.en: Cross-task memory raises a related concern about the order of tasks. Accumulating experience over a sequence of tasks, i.e., online learning, is not leakage by itself, as it mirrors how practitioners gain experience over time. However, when the memory keeps accumulating across the target tasks themselves, a task may be solved after another task that it influenced. Avoiding leakage thus requires a chronological or causal ordering of the tasks. These practices have been raised as a fairness concern on the MLE-bench leaderboard ( timeleft–, 2026 ) , which is one of the reasons that the leaderboard has paused new submissions. Contamination-free benchmarks in code generation address a similar problem by evaluating only on problems released after the model’s training cutoff ( Jain et al., 2025 ) ; MLE-InsightBench (§ 3 ) applies a similar principle to insight sources by using only competitions that cannot have been influenced by the target tasks.

paragraphs.en: Competition collection . We collect Kaggle competitions using Meta Kaggle ( Kaggle, 2026c ) and Meta Kaggle Code ( Kaggle, 2026b ) . We retain competitions that are launched in 2020 or later, use Python, have downloadable datasets, and have high-performing self-contained solutions, and exclude playground competitions; a solution counts as high-performing and self-contained if it received a gold medal and uses no datasets other than the competition’s own. This step yields 191 competitions, from which we manually remove 18 that do not involve training ML models (simulation competitions and optimization puzzles, such as the Santa series ( Reade and Oldacre, 2025 ) ), leaving 173 candidate competitions. For each competition, we collect the task description, the public writeups of the teams ranked within the gold-medal zone of the leaderboard, and the high-performing self-contained solution notebooks; we refer to the latter two as the competition’s human-written solutions.

paragraphs.en: Domain clustering . We group the candidate competitions by clustering their natural-language descriptions (overview and dataset description), and then manually assign a human-readable label to each cluster. We embed each description with harrier-oss-v1-27b ( Microsoft, 2026 ) , a text embedding model, by instructing it to cluster competitions by ML task formulation and application domain. This yields 12 clusters and 7 outliers (unable to be clustered), as shown in Figure 3 . We label each cluster by inspecting its member competitions and its most distinctive terms under class-based TF-IDF ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) , and manually move the outlier WiDS Datathon 2022 ( Matthys et al., 2022 ) into the cluster that contains its other editions. Domains serve two purposes: they define the scope of domain insights, and they ensure that every target task has closely-related peer tasks from which insights can be assembled. We exclude the Audio Recognition cluster, where none of its 8 competitions satisfies the eligibility rule for target tasks described below, as well as 4 other competitions without any writeup from the gold-medal zone, and Jane Street Market Prediction ( cnyberg et al., 2020 ) , whose dataset was available at our initial collection but is no longer publicly accessible. The resulting MLE-InsightBench consists of 160 competitions in 12 domains, including a residual domain labeled Other for the remaining outliers.

paragraphs.en: Held-out split . From each domain, we hold out one eligible competition as a target task and use the remaining 148 competitions as source competitions. A competition is eligible if the mean runtime of its collected solutions is at most the 75th percentile of the runtimes of all collected solution notebooks (25.5 minutes), which keeps the evaluation within a fixed compute budget. We also manually mark some competitions as ineligible where the executable environment for the tasks are hard to replicate (e.g., using a huge dataset): AMP Parkinson’s Disease Progression Prediction ( Kirsch et al., 2023 ) , Drawing with LLMs ( Holbrook et al., 2025 ) , Bengali.AI Speech Recognition ( Howard et al., 2023 ) , Cornell Birdcall Identification ( Howard et al., 2020 ) , and the BirdCLEF series (e.g., BirdCLEF+ 2025 ( Klinck et al., 2025 ) ). Among the eligible competitions of the most recent year in a domain, we select the one with the shortest solution runtime.

paragraphs.en: The resulting non-descendant split ensures that every source competition is a causal non-descendant of its target task, i.e., a competition that cannot have been influenced by the target task as a later edition of the same series or reusing its solutions. This mirrors how insights would be used in practice: an agentic MLE system facing a new task can draw on prior experience, but not on experience derived from the new task itself. While a chronological split (i.e., choosing the latest competition of each domain) is more straightforward, it would reduce the size of benchmark because the latest competitions sometimes are not eligible as a target task, causing dropping of valuable source competitions that could otherwise be used with our more careful split. Table 1 lists the 12 target tasks, of which 9 are standard competitions with a submission file and 3 are code competitions whose predictions are produced through a competition-specific evaluation API.
paragraphs.zh: 由此产生的非后代划分确保了每个源竞赛都是其目标任务的因果非后代，也就是说，该竞赛不可能受到目标任务的影响，例如作为同一系列的后续版本或重复使用其解决方案。 这反映了实际中洞察力的使用方式：一个智能体 MLE 系统在面对新任务时，可以利用先前的经验，但不能利用来自新任务本身的经验。 虽然按时间顺序划分（即选择每个领域最新的竞赛）更为直接，但这会减少基准测试的规模，因为最新的竞赛有时不适合作为目标任务，导致一些原本可以通过我们更谨慎的划分使用的宝贵源竞赛被排除在外。 表 1 列出了 12 个目标任务，其中 9 个是带有提交文件的标准竞赛，另外 3 个是代码竞赛，其预测结果需要通过特定的竞赛评估 API 生成。

paragraphs.en: Leakage control . MLE-InsightBench controls the sources of insights at three points. First, the materials of the target tasks (datasets, descriptions, writeups, and solutions) are excluded from insight assembly, so no assembled insight can be derived from a target task’s own winning solutions. Second, because the split only requires the source competitions to be causal non-descendants of the target task, earlier editions of a recurring competition series (e.g., March Machine Learning Mania) remain legitimate source competitions, as they would be for a practitioner. Third, the agentic MLE system under evaluation is not given web-search tools and receives only the public data of the target task; the private-test inputs are substituted only when the final solution is graded (same as how Kaggle grades submissions), and the private-test labels are never exposed.
paragraphs.zh: 信息泄露控制。 MLE-InsightBench 在三个环节对洞察来源进行控制。 首先，目标任务的素材（数据集、描述、说明文和解决方案）被排除在洞察整合之外，因此无法从目标任务自身的获胜解决方案中推导出任何整合后的洞察。 其次，由于该划分仅要求源竞赛是目标任务的因果非后代，因此重复举办的竞赛系列（例如 March Machine Learning Mania）的早期版本仍属于合法的源竞赛，这与从业者的处理方式一致。 第三，正在评估的智能体 MLE 系统不会获得网络搜索工具，仅接收目标任务的相关公开数据；只有在最终解决方案被评分时才会替换私有测试输入（与 Kaggle 的提交评分方式相同），且私有测试标签绝不会暴露。

paragraphs.en: MLE-InsightForge (Figure 4 (a)) is a ReAct-style agent ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , using gpt-5.6-sol-pro as its backend LLM during our study. sents.en: The agent’s tools read files and notebooks, inspect datasets, run targeted analyses in a sandboxed container (e.g., checking a preprocessing step or a validation split claimed in a writeup, without rerunning the solution end-to-end), and read the materials linked from writeups, such as web pages, PDFs, code repositories, images, and videos.
sents.zh: 该智能体的工具能够读取文件和笔记本、检查数据集、在隔离容器中运行针对性分析（例如，验证写稿中提到的预处理步骤或验证分割，而无需从头到尾重新运行整个解决方案），以及读取写稿中链接的材料，如网页、PDF、代码仓库、图像和视频。

paragraphs.en: Leakage prevention . The source materials are mounted read-only in the agent’s workspace, which contains only the source competitions and not the target tasks. paragraphs.en: Evidence-based submission . The agent submits each insight through a validated submission interface, which rejects the submission until the agent has read every required source in full, otherwise returns the incomplete insight to the agent for repair. To minimize hallucination, the interface also requires an evidence record for every insight, listing the original source passages it is based on; this ensures that every insight can be traced back to its original source.

paragraphs.en: Competition insights . MLE-InsightForge first reads the description to identify the objective, data, metric, and constraints, and then reads every collected writeup in full. It consults the solution notebooks to disambiguate implementation details and to check that a technique claimed in a writeup is actually present, and inspects the datasets to understand their characteristics and to check claims about them. The resulting insight is organized around the decisions that distinguished the winning solutions and states the conditions under which each decision was made, rather than reproducing a particular solution, since the insight is used for other tasks, to which a complete solution tailored to the source competition’s data and metric does not transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 竞赛洞察。 MLE-InsightForge 首先阅读描述以明确目标、数据、指标和约束条件，然后完整阅读所有收集到的报告。 它会参考解决方案笔记本以澄清实现细节，并验证报告中声称使用的技术是否确实存在；同时检查数据集以了解其特性，并核实相关声明。 最终的洞察将重点放在区分获胜解决方案的关键决策上，并说明每项决策成立的条件，而非复现某个具体方案，因为该洞察用于其他任务，而针对源竞赛数据和指标量身定制的完整方案无法直接迁移到这些任务中。

paragraphs.en: Domain insights . A target task has no insight of its own, but it shares task properties with the other competitions in its domain. MLE-InsightForge reads the descriptions and competition insights of all source competitions in the domain and reconciles recommendations that recur, complement each other, or conflict. It replaces competition-specific prescriptions with conditional guidance; for example, it associates a validation strategy with grouped subjects or temporal deployment rather than as universally applicable. A domain insight drops recommendations specific to a single competition, keeping only those supported by several competitions or a task archetype.
paragraphs.zh: 领域洞察。 目标任务本身没有独立的洞察，但它与该领域其他竞赛共享任务属性。 MLE-InsightForge 会读取该领域中所有源竞赛的描述和竞赛洞察，并对重复出现、相互补充或相互冲突的建议进行协调。 它将特定于某项竞赛的指导方针替换为条件性指导；例如，它会将验证策略与分组对象或时间部署相关联，而非作为普遍适用的策略。 领域洞察会舍弃仅针对单一竞赛的建议，只保留得到多个竞赛或任务原型支持的建议。

paragraphs.en: Improvement insights . While the other two types describe the decisions behind the final solutions, improvement insights capture how their authors diagnosed and fixed problems along the way, by connecting an observed problem (e.g., a validation split that does not match the deployment setting, or an inference pipeline that exceeds the runtime budget) to the resolution that fixed it. MLE-InsightForge first filters writeups, with an LLM, for those that report both a concrete problem and an actionable resolution. For each retained writeup, it then assembles standalone insights, keeping only those whose outcome is directly reported in the writeup; this step yields 1,068 raw improvement insights. Because many improvement strategies recur across competitions, exposing all of them individually would make them costly to discover and highly redundant. We therefore cluster the raw improvement insights by their descriptions, using the same approach as Domain Clustering (§ 3 ), and let MLE-InsightForge synthesize each cluster into one consolidated insight under the same evidence constraints. Specifically, we embed the text of each raw insight with harrier-oss-v1-27b , using an instruction to identify the prediction task type, data modality, and application domain that the insight targets, and cluster the embeddings with UMAP (15 dimensions, 20 neighbors) and HDBSCAN (minimum cluster size 20, minimum samples 5); we select these hyperparameters by a grid search for clusters that are stable across random seeds, align with the data modality and solution stage of the insights, and cover most insights. This yields 15 clusters, and the outliers (4.9% of the raw insights) form the residual cluster, as shown in Figure 5 . MLE-InsightForge then synthesizes each cluster into one consolidated improvement insight, including one for the residual cluster, resulting in 16 improvement insights. A manifest records the member insights and evidence of each cluster, so that every improvement insight remains traceable to its raw ones.
paragraphs.zh: 改进见解。 虽然另外两种类型描述了最终解决方案背后的决策，但改进见解则捕捉了作者在此过程中如何诊断和解决问题：通过将观察到的问题（例如，验证集与部署设置不匹配，或推理流程超出运行时间预算）与其对应的解决方案联系起来。 MLE-InsightForge 首先借助 LLM 筛选写稿，保留那些既报告了具体问题又提供了可行解决方案的写稿。 对于每篇保留的写稿，它随后会整合独立的见解，仅保留其结果在写稿中有直接说明的部分；此步骤共产生 1,068 条原始改进见解。 由于许多改进策略在不同竞赛中反复出现，若单独列出所有策略，会导致发现成本高昂且内容高度重复。 因此，我们采用与领域聚类（§ 3）相同的方法，根据描述对原始改进见解进行聚类，并让 MLE-InsightForge 在相同的证据约束下，将每个聚类合成为一条整合后的见解。 具体而言，我们使用 harrier-oss-v1-27b 嵌入每条原始见解的文本，并通过指令明确该见解所针对的预测任务类型、数据模态和应用领域；随后使用 UMAP（15 维，20 个邻居）和 HDBSCAN（最小聚类大小 20，最小样本数 5）对嵌入结果进行聚类；我们通过网格搜索选择这些超参数，以确保生成的聚类在不同随机种子下保持稳定、与见解的数据模态和解决方案阶段一致，并能覆盖大多数见解。 此过程共产生 15 个聚类，而离群点（占原始见解的 4.9%）则构成剩余聚类，如图 5 所示。 接着，MLE-InsightForge 将每个聚类合成为一条整合后的改进见解（包括剩余聚类的一条），最终得到 16 条改进见解。 一份清单记录了每个聚类的成员见解和证据，从而确保每条改进见解都能追溯至其原始来源。

paragraphs.en: A competition insight or domain insight consists of insight items following the trigger–action pattern: a trigger (a task or data condition that can be checked before acting), one recommended action, and a rationale for its expected effect. Triggers are phrased in terms of general task and data properties, so the agentic MLE system can skip the items that do not apply to its task; conflicting findings are kept as items with mutually exclusive triggers. The items are grouped by five aspects of an ML solution (data modality, data, model, training, and other) and ordered within each aspect by the cost of following them. An improvement insight is a single item whose trigger is the observed problem and whose action is the resolution, elaborated with its limitations, cost, and how to check whether it worked. Each insight has a name and a description; its evidence records are stored separately and enter the context only if explicitly read.
paragraphs.zh: 竞赛洞察或领域洞察由遵循“触发–行动”模式的洞察条目组成：一个触发条件（可在采取行动前检查的任务或数据条件）、一项推荐行动，以及对其预期效果的说明。 触发条件以通用任务和数据属性来表述，因此智能体 MLE 系统可以跳过不适用于其任务的条目；相互冲突的发现则作为具有互斥触发条件的条目保留。 这些条目按机器学习解决方案的五个方面（数据模态、数据、模型、训练和其他）进行分组，并在每个方面内按照执行它们的成本排序。 改进洞察是一个单独条目，其触发条件是观察到的问题，行动是解决方案，并进一步说明其局限性、成本以及验证其是否生效的方法。 每个洞察都有名称和描述；其证据记录单独存储，只有在被明确读取时才会进入上下文。

paragraphs.en: The assembled insights can be injected into any agentic MLE system that accepts textual context. In our study, we inject them into a ReAct-style agentic MLE system that develops solutions in an isolated container with access to the public data of the target task, whose workflow is shown in Figure 6 . The system can inspect data, edit files, execute candidate solutions, and validate submissions. Each execution is recorded as a node in a solution tree, so the system can branch from an earlier candidate when a modification fails, similar to AIDE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . At the deadline, the selected solution is rerun from scratch on the private-test inputs and graded outside the agent loop. Without insights, this system is the Baseline of our evaluation (§ 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 整合后的见解可以注入到任何接受文本上下文的智能体式 MLE 系统中。 在我们的研究中，我们将这些见解注入到一个 ReAct 风格的智能体式 MLE 系统中，该系统在一个隔离容器中开发解决方案，并能访问目标任务的公开数据，其工作流程如图 6 所示。 该系统可以检查数据、编辑文件、执行候选解决方案并验证提交结果。 每次执行都会被记录为解决方案树中的一个节点，因此当某个修改失败时，系统可以从更早的候选方案分支，这与 AIDE（Jiang 等人，2025）类似。 在截止日期时，选定的解决方案会从头开始在私有测试输入上重新运行，并在智能体循环之外进行评分。 如果没有这些见解，该系统就是我们评估中的基线方法（§ 5）。

paragraphs.en: For a target task, the system receives the domain insight of the task’s domain, the competition insights of the source competitions in the same domain, and all improvement insights, which are assembled from the source competitions of every domain (Figure 7 ). The two injection modes hold the insights, system, prompt, harness, task, and budget constant, and only change when the competition insights and improvement insights enter the context; the domain insight is always in the initial context.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个目标任务，系统会接收该任务所在领域的领域洞察、同一领域中源竞赛的竞争洞察以及所有改进洞察，这些改进洞察是从每个领域的源竞赛中汇总而来的（图7）。 两种注入模式保持洞察、系统、提示词、工具包、任务和预算不变，仅当竞争洞察和改进洞察进入上下文时才会发生变化；领域洞察始终存在于初始上下文中。

paragraphs.en: Skill mode . Following the progressive-disclosure design of Agent Skills ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , the initial context lists only compact metadata (name and short description) of each available insight. This mode preserves context for task observations and execution feedback, but its benefit depends on the system recognizing a relevant insight from its description and retrieving it.
paragraphs.zh: 技能模式。 遵循 Agent Skills（Anthropic，2025）的渐进式披露设计，初始上下文仅列出每个可用洞察的紧凑型元数据（名称和简短描述）。 该模式保留了任务观察和执行反馈的上下文，但其效果取决于系统能否根据描述识别出相关洞察并将其检索出来。

sents.zh: 技能模式。

paragraphs.en: Playbook mode . Following the use of evolving playbooks as agent context ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , the full texts of all available insights are rendered directly into the system prompt before the system begins. This mode removes the retrieval decision and makes every insight immediately available, at the cost of a longer context that may contain insights irrelevant to, or inconsistent with, the target task.
paragraphs.zh: 剧本模式。 继将不断演进的剧本用作智能体上下文（Zhang 等人，2026a）之后，所有可用洞察的完整文本会在系统开始运行前直接渲染到系统提示中。 此模式会移除检索决策，使每个洞察都能立即使用，但代价是上下文更长，其中可能包含与目标任务无关或与其不一致的洞察。

paragraphs.en: The assembled insights are not tied to MLE-InsightBench : a new competition from outside it can use them in the same way as a target task. For one or a few new competitions, the only step needed is to determine the domain of each competition, either manually or by embedding its description as in Domain Clustering (§ 3 ) and assigning it to the closest cluster; the domain insight and competition insights of that domain and all improvement insights are then directly usable without further assembly.
paragraphs.zh: 已整合的见解并不局限于 MLE-InsightBench：来自其外部的新竞赛可以像目标任务一样使用这些见解。 对于一项或少数几项新竞赛，唯一需要的步骤是确定每项竞赛的领域——无论是手动完成，还是通过将其描述嵌入到“领域聚类”（§3）中并分配至最近的聚类；之后，该领域的领域见解、竞赛见解以及所有改进见解都可以直接使用，无需进一步整合。

paragraphs.en: Once a new competition has ended and its writeups and solutions are available, it can be added as a source competition by an incremental update that reruns only the affected assembly tasks. Re-clustering is needed only when many competitions have been added, which may shift the cluster structure, or when a new competition belongs to no existing domain.

paragraphs.en: We illustrate the assembly and usage of insights with the competition Energy Behavior of Prosumers, the target task of the Time Series Prediction domain. The task asks for hourly forecasts of the electricity produced and consumed by Estonian customers with solar panels, given weather forecasts, energy prices, and client data such as the installed photovoltaic capacity, and is evaluated by mean absolute error (MAE). Predictions are made through a time-series API that serves the test data day by day, in which the latest revealed targets and client data lag two days behind the prediction times. The four source competitions of the domain forecast COVID-19 cases, microbusiness density, and retail sales, and none of them involves energy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以“能源生产消费者的能源行为”竞赛为例，说明洞察的整合与使用；该竞赛是时间序列预测领域的目标任务。 该任务要求在给定天气预报、能源价格以及客户数据（如已安装的光伏装机容量）的情况下，对爱沙尼亚配备太阳能电池板的客户每小时产生的电力和消耗的电力进行预测，并以平均绝对误差（MAE）作为评估指标。 预测通过一个时间序列 API 完成，该 API 按天提供测试数据，其中最新披露的目标和客户数据比预测时间滞后两天。 该领域的四个源竞赛分别预测了 COVID-19 病例、微型企业密度和零售销售额，但没有任何一个涉及能源领域。

paragraphs.en: Insights . Figure 8(a) shows excerpts of the three types of insights available for this task. Three aspects of the domain insight have triggers that hold for Energy Behavior of Prosumers: target lags anchored at least one horizon behind each target match the two-day delay of the revealed targets, the denominator normalization matches the production that scales with the installed capacity, which grows over time, and aligning external features to their publication vintage matches the two-day delay of the client data. The competition insight of GoDaddy Microbusiness Density Forecasting ( Howard et al., 2022a ) contains the items from which and are generalized, whereas other items, such as the one on entities with tiny counts, have triggers that do not hold and can be skipped. The improvement insight deployment-contract-temporal-backtesting recommends accepting a candidate solution only if it improves in a backtest that replays the serving contract, i.e., the available history, the gap, and the horizon, across several forecast origins, which requires matching the information available at each origin.
paragraphs.zh: 洞见。 图 8(a) 展示了本任务中可用的三种类型洞见的摘录。 领域洞见的三个方面具有适用于“能源生产-消费者行为”的触发条件：锚定在每个目标至少一个时间步之后的目标滞后，与已揭示目标的两日延迟相匹配；分母归一化与随安装容量而变化的产量相匹配，且该产量会随时间增长；将外部特征与其发布年份对齐，则与客户端数据的两日延迟相匹配。 GoDaddy 微型企业密度预测（Howard 等人，2022a）的竞争洞见包含了被泛化的项目，而其他项目（例如关于数量极小实体的项目）的触发条件并不成立，因此可以跳过。 “改进洞见：部署合同时间回溯测试”建议仅在接受候选解决方案时，若该方案在回溯测试中表现更佳，才予以采纳；该回溯测试需重演服务合同，即可用历史数据、差距和时间范围，并覆盖多个预测起点，这要求与每个起点处可用的信息相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Impact on the solutions . Over six runs each, the agentic MLE system reaches a private-test MAE of 228 ± \pm 76.8 without insights and 64.8 ± \pm 6.15 with insights (lower is better, since MAE measures the prediction error). Figure 8(b) compares the final solutions of a run without insights and a run with insights, in which all three insights are injected via the playbook mode. The solution without insights anchors its rolling target means only two hours before each prediction time and joins the client data of the same day, although the API reveals the targets and client data only two days later. Its hold-out validation on the training data cannot detect this mismatch and reports an MAE of 29.24; at prediction time, the rolling means and the capacity are missing (the client data served by the API is ignored), filled with zeros, and the private-test MAE rises to 234.15. The solution with insights makes three changes that implement the highlighted insight parts: it computes its rolling means only from target lags of at least 48 hours, it learns the production per unit of installed capacity and rescales its predictions by the capacity, and it joins the client data as of two days earlier, both in training and from the data served by the API. Its validation MAE (31.91) is worse but reflects the deployment setting, and its private-test MAE is 57.12.
paragraphs.zh: 对解决方案的影响。 在每次运行超过六次的情况下，智能体 MLE 系统在无洞察时达到私有测试 MAE 为 228 ± \pm 76.8，而在有洞察时则达到 64.8 ± \pm 6.15（数值越低越好，因为 MAE 衡量的是预测误差）。 图 8(b) 比较了无洞察运行和有洞察运行的最终解决方案，其中所有三个洞察都通过剧本模式注入。 无洞察的解决方案仅在每次预测时间前两小时锚定其滚动目标均值，并结合当天的客户端数据，尽管 API 直到两天后才披露目标和客户端数据。 其在训练数据上的预留验证无法检测出这种不匹配，并报告 MAE 为 29.24；在预测时，滚动均值和容量缺失（API 提供的客户端数据被忽略），并用零填充，导致私有测试 MAE 上升至 234.15。 有洞察的解决方案实施了三个变化，以应用突出显示的洞察部分：它仅从至少 48 小时的目标滞后计算滚动均值，学习单位安装容量的产量，并根据容量重新缩放预测值，同时在训练和 API 提供的数据中结合两天前的客户端数据。 其验证 MAE（31.91）较高，但这反映了部署设置，而私有测试 MAE 为 57.12。

sents.en: Its hold-out validation on the training data cannot detect this mismatch and reports an MAE of 29.24; at prediction time, the rolling means and the capacity are missing (the client data served by the API is ignored), filled with zeros, and the private-test MAE rises to 234.15.
sents.zh: 其在训练数据上的预留验证无法检测出这种不匹配，并报告 MAE 为 29.24；在预测时，滚动均值和容量缺失（API 提供的客户端数据被忽略），并用零填充，导致私有测试 MAE 上升至 234.15。

sents.en: The solution with insights makes three changes that implement the highlighted insight parts: it computes its rolling means only from target lags of at least 48 hours, it learns the production per unit of installed capacity and rescales its predictions by the capacity, and it joins the client data as of two days earlier, both in training and from the data served by the API.
sents.zh: 有洞察的解决方案实施了三个变化，以应用突出显示的洞察部分：它仅从至少 48 小时的目标滞后计算滚动均值，学习单位安装容量的产量，并根据容量重新缩放预测值，同时在训练和 API 提供的数据中结合两天前的客户端数据。

sents.en: Its validation MAE (31.91) is worse but reflects the deployment setting, and its private-test MAE is 57.12.
sents.zh: 其验证 MAE（31.91）较高，但这反映了部署设置，而私有测试 MAE 为 57.12。

paragraphs.en: To measure cost, we record the input, reasoning, and output tokens consumed by the backend LLM and the wall-clock time of each run. We convert the tokens to a monetary cost at the OpenRouter API prices of deepseek-v4-flash-0731 : $0.44 per million uncached input tokens, $0.014 per million cached input tokens, and $1.32 per million output tokens, where the output tokens include the reasoning tokens. For each task and condition, we report the mean with a 95% Student- t t confidence interval, and compare each condition with Baseline using a two-sided Mann–Whitney U U test ( Mann and Whitney, 1947 ) at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . Since each condition is compared with Baseline on 12 tasks, we also report the number of significant tasks after the Holm–Bonferroni correction ( Holm, 1979 ) over the tasks of each condition. Every condition has 72 runs, i.e., six runs per task. In addition to the private-test score of the final solution, we analyze the validation scores that the system measures on its own validation split for every scored candidate solution during development, which show how the solution quality evolves over time. The validation scores are normalized in the same way as private-test scores; at each minute, we take the median over the runs of a task and average it over tasks.

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 (a, b) shows that the insights help both in drafting the initial solution and in improving it: the first scored solutions of Full-skill and Full-playbook are 1.8 and 2.9 points above those of Baseline; they reach the final best score of Baseline after 80 and 40 minutes, and end with gains of 7.8 and 5.9 points over the first solution of Baseline, compared with 3.3 points for Baseline itself.
paragraphs.zh: 图9（a、b）显示，这些洞见既有助于起草初始解决方案，也有助于改进该方案：Full-skill和Full-playbook的首轮得分分别比Baseline高出1.8分和2.9分；它们在80分钟和40分钟内达到了Baseline的最终最佳得分，并且与Baseline的首轮得分相比，最终分别获得了7.8分和5.9分的提升，而Baseline自身的提升仅为3.3分。

paragraphs.en: We compare Full-playbook with the single-type ablations (last three columns of Table 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Each type of insight alone improves the normalized score over Baseline (0.302): to 0.595 with domain insights (96.9%), 0.608 with competition insights (101.4%), and 0.611 with improvement insights (102.1%). All three remain below Full-playbook (0.673). Hence, the three types are complementary rather than redundant, and their benefits accumulate when combined. paragraphs.en: Overall, the two injection modes reach similar normalized scores (0.676 for Full-skill and 0.673 for Full-playbook in Table 3 ), but the better mode varies across tasks. Full-playbook has the higher mean score on 6 tasks and Full-skill on 6; notably, Full-playbook falls below Baseline on POG Series S01E01 (though not significantly), whereas Full-skill stays above it. A playbook guarantees that every insight is seen but can steer the system toward insights that do not fit the task, whereas skills let the system skip irrelevant insights but depend on it retrieving the relevant ones. Although Full-skill reaches a similar score to Full-playbook, its trajectories show that the system rarely retrieves the full text of a skill: only 19 of its 72 runs call read_skill at all, 14 of them to read a competition insight (typically that of the most similar source competition, e.g., Image Matching Challenge 2024 ( Bellavia et al., 2024 ) for Image Matching 2025) and 5 to read an improvement insight. The improvement of Full-skill therefore stems mostly from what every run receives in its initial context rather than from the retrieved texts: the domain insight, with which D-playbook alone reaches 0.595, and the metadata of the skills, whose descriptions state when each insight applies, e.g., the problem that each improvement insight resolves. The two modes also lead to different correct predictions (Figure 10 (a)): 5,376 private-test items are predicted correctly only by Full-skill and 4,918 only by Full-playbook, compared with 3,838 only by Baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，两种注入模式达到了相近的归一化分数（表3中全技能模式为0.676，全剧本模式为0.673），但更优的模式因任务而异。 全剧本模式在6项任务中的平均分数更高，而全技能模式则在另外6项任务中表现更优；值得注意的是，全剧本模式在POG系列S01E01中的得分低于基线模型（尽管差异不显著），而全技能模式则始终高于基线模型。 剧本模式能确保每个洞察都被识别，但可能引导系统关注与任务无关的洞察；而技能模式则允许系统跳过无关的洞察，但依赖于系统能否检索到相关的洞察。 尽管全技能模式的得分与全剧本模式相近，但其运行轨迹显示，系统很少检索技能的完整文本：在72次运行中，仅有19次调用了read_skill函数，其中14次用于读取竞赛洞察（通常是与最相似源竞赛相关的洞察，例如图像匹配2025任务中读取图像匹配挑战2024（Bellavia等，2024）的洞察），另有5次用于读取改进洞察。 因此，全技能模式的提升主要源于每次运行在初始上下文中接收到的内容，而非检索到的文本：包括领域洞察（仅D-剧本模式就达到了0.595的得分）以及技能元数据，其中描述了每个洞察的适用场景，例如每个改进洞察所解决的问题。 两种模式还导致了不同的正确预测结果（图10(a)）：有5,376个私有测试样本仅由全技能模式正确预测，4,918个仅由全剧本模式正确预测，而基线模型单独正确预测的样本为3,838个。

As shown in Table 5 , the insights are not specific to one backend LLM: on the normalized scale over both tasks, they also improve GPT-6.1-Sol by 80.3% with Full-skill and 61.9% with Full-playbook. GPT-6.1-Sol is a stronger backend than deepseek-v4-flash-0731 on Image Matching 2025: its Baseline already reaches an mAA of 42.8, close to the gold-medal threshold of the human leaderboard (43.34). Although the improvement is smaller than with deepseek-v4-flash-0731 , the insights still significantly improve the normalized score by 427.9% with Full-skill and 326.9% with Full-playbook, lifting the mean mAA beyond the gold-medal threshold (52.0 and 49.9). On POG Series S01E01, where the insights do not help deepseek-v4-flash-0731 , they improve the normalized score of GPT-6.1-Sol by 38.2% with Full-skill and 29.8% with Full-playbook, although not significantly over six runs; this suggests that a stronger backend LLM can make better use of the insights. Still, no condition with either backend LLM reaches the median of the human leaderboard on this task (MAE 0.016845), so the tasks of MLE-InsightBench remain challenging for future agentic MLE systems. Unlike deepseek-v4-flash-0731 , GPT-6.1-Sol actively retrieves skills: 12 of its 12 Full-skill runs call read_skill (12 for improvement insights and 6 for competition insights), which may explain why Full-skill beats Full-playbook with GPT-6.1-Sol on both tasks.

sents.zh: 在 POG Series S01E01 任务上，这些洞见对 deepseek-v4-flash-0731 没有帮助，但它们仍通过 Full-skill 将 GPT-6.1-Sol 的归一化分数提升了 38.2%，通过 Full-playbook 提升了 29.8%（尽管在六次运行中提升并不显著）；这表明更强的后端 LLM 能更有效地利用这些洞见。

sents.en: Still, no condition with either backend LLM reaches the median of the human leaderboard on this task (MAE 0.016845), so the tasks of MLE-InsightBench remain challenging for future agentic MLE systems.
sents.zh: 然而，无论使用哪种后端 LLM，都没有任何条件在此任务上达到人类排行榜的中位数（MAE 0.016845），因此 MLE-InsightBench 的任务对于未来的智能体式 MLE 系统而言仍然充满挑战。

sents.en: Unlike deepseek-v4-flash-0731 , GPT-6.1-Sol actively retrieves skills: 12 of its 12 Full-skill runs call read_skill (12 for improvement insights and 6 for competition insights), which may explain why Full-skill beats Full-playbook with GPT-6.1-Sol on both tasks.
sents.zh: 与 deepseek-v4-flash-0731 不同，GPT-6.1-Sol 会主动检索技能：在其 12 次 Full-skill 运行中，有 12 次调用了 read_skill（其中 12 次用于提升洞见，6 次用于竞赛洞见），这或许可以解释为何在两项任务中，GPT-6.1-Sol 使用 Full-skill 的表现优于 Full-playbook。

paragraphs.en: The two backend LLMs also develop solutions differently: on Image Matching 2025, GPT-6.1-Sol creates its first solution node earlier (median step 19 vs. 165), uses most of the 12-hour budget (594–629 minutes), and tries 9.2–13.3 solution nodes per run, whereas deepseek-v4-flash-0731 usually submits its final solution after 210–320 minutes with 2.5–4.0 nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 两款后端 LLM 在解决方案的生成方式上也有所不同：在 Image Matching 2025 任务中，GPT-6.1-Sol 会更早创建第一个解决方案节点（中位数为第 19 步，对比为第 165 步），几乎用完了 12 小时的全部预算（594–629 分钟），并且每次运行会尝试 9.2–13.3 个解决方案节点；而 deepseek-v4-flash-0731 通常在运行 210–320 分钟后提交最终解决方案，此时仅使用 2.5–4.0 个节点。

paragraphs.en: Task scope . MLE-InsightBench is derived from Kaggle competitions, which provide realistic end-to-end MLE tasks but do not represent every production setting. Kaggle emphasizes predictive performance under a fixed metric and submission interface, whereas deployed machine learning systems also require maintainability, monitoring, fairness, and privacy.

paragraphs.en: Models and costs . The main results use one backend LLM for the agentic MLE system and one LLM for MLE-InsightForge , so they may depend on these models’ knowledge, tool-use behavior, and long-context capabilities; RQ4 studies the former dependency. The 12-hour, GPU-backed budget also limits accessibility and may favor approaches that spend more compute. Assembling the insights from all 148 source competitions with gpt-5.6-sol-pro cost $903 USD ($1,544 USD including runs repeated during development), a one-time cost that is amortized over all tasks of a domain. The experiments are also costly: with deepseek-v4-flash-0731 , each condition takes 11.4–16.9 GPU days and $124–$144 in API costs, and with GPT-6.1-Sol , the API costs of a condition on all 12 target tasks would reach $957, extrapolated from up to $160 on two tasks. Running MLE-InsightForge with a different backend LLM may yield different findings, which our budget precludes evaluating; to facilitate reproduction and such evaluations by others, we open-source our workflow and insights.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与成本。 主要结果中，智能体 MLE 系统使用一个后端 LLM，而 MLE-InsightForge 则使用另一个 LLM，因此这些结果可能依赖于这些模型的知识、工具使用行为以及长上下文处理能力；RQ4 研究了前一种依赖关系。 持续 12 小时且依赖 GPU 的预算也限制了可访问性，并可能更倾向于那些消耗更多计算资源的方法。 使用 gpt-5.6-sol-pro 整合全部 148 个源竞赛的洞察共花费 903 美元（包括开发期间重复运行的费用为 1,544 美元），这是一次性成本，可在该领域的所有任务中摊销。 这些实验的成本也很高：使用 deepseek-v4-flash-0731 时，每个条件需要 11.4–16.9 GPU 天以及 124–144 美元的 API 费用；而使用 GPT-6.1-Sol 时，在所有 12 个目标任务上运行一个条件的 API 费用将达到 957 美元（根据最多在两个任务上花费 160 美元的数据外推得出）。 使用不同的后端 LLM 运行 MLE-InsightForge 可能会产生不同的发现，但我们的预算不允许对此进行评估；为了便于他人复现并进行此类评估，我们已将工作流程和洞察成果开源。

paragraphs.en: Agentic MLE . MLAgentBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) evaluates LLM agents that design, run, and revise ML experiments, and MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) evaluates end-to-end solutions of Kaggle competitions against private-test labels. The systems on the MLE-bench leaderboard mostly advance the search over candidate solutions ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Toledo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) and, increasingly, the use of insights from other tasks (§ 2.2 ). Systems that use insights couple a particular source of insights with a particular agent scaffold, and evaluate the combination as a whole on MLE-bench. Our work is complementary: rather than proposing another scaffold, we hold the agentic MLE system fixed and study how the assembled insights, their types, and their injection modes affect it on a benchmark whose source competitions are fixed and disjoint from the target tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式 MLE。 MLAgentBench（Huang 等，2024）评估能够设计、执行和修订机器学习实验的 LLM 智能体，而 MLE-bench（Chan 等，2025）则评估 Kaggle 竞赛的全端解决方案在私有测试标签上的表现。 MLE-bench 排行榜上的系统主要改进候选解决方案的搜索过程（Jiang 等，2025；Liu 等，2025；Toledo 等，2025；Li 等，2025；Wan 等，2025；Yang 等，2025），并且越来越多地利用来自其他任务的洞见（§ 2.2）。 使用洞见的系统会将特定的洞见来源与特定的智能体框架相结合，并在 MLE-bench 上对这一组合进行整体评估。 我们的工作具有互补性：我们并非提出另一种新框架，而是保持智能体式 MLE 系统不变，研究整合后的洞见、其类型以及注入模式如何影响该系统，而基准测试的源竞赛是固定且与目标任务分离的。

paragraphs.en: Program synthesis for ML code . Before LLM agents, program synthesis targeted ML code by searching a restricted space of programs. BLAZE ( Wang et al., 2018 ) synthesizes tensor transformations in a MATLAB-like DSL from input–output examples, and TF-Coder ( Shi et al., 2022 ) enumerates expressions over TensorFlow operations, prioritized by learned models; INTENT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) lets users decompose hard tensor transformations, and HySynth ( Barke et al., 2024 ) guides the search with a grammar learned from LLM completions. Nam et al. ( Nam et al., 2022 ) predict the sequence of PyTorch and TensorFlow API calls that transforms the inputs into the outputs to guide enumerative search. At a coarser granularity, AutoML-Zero ( Real et al., 2020 ) evolves complete ML algorithms from basic mathematical operations, NEAR ( Shah et al., 2020 ) and dPADS ( Cui and Zhu, 2021 ) search for differentiable programs in a DSL, and Marinescu et al. ( Marinescu et al., 2021 ) search ML pipelines defined by a context-free grammar. These techniques synthesize short programs or pipelines within a predefined search space, whereas an agentic MLE system writes an end-to-end solution in a general-purpose language; the insights assembled by MLE-InsightForge play a role similar to their learned priors, steering the system toward decisions that worked on related tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 机器学习代码的程序合成。 在大型语言模型智能体出现之前，程序合成通过搜索受限的程序空间来生成机器学习代码。 BLAZE（Wang 等人，2018）基于输入-输出示例，在类 MATLAB 的 DSL 中合成张量变换；TF-Coder（Shi 等人，2022）则枚举 TensorFlow 操作中的表达式，并由学习模型决定优先顺序；INTENT（Zhou 等人，2022）允许用户分解复杂的张量变换，而 HySynth（Barke 等人，2024）则通过从大型语言模型补全中学习到的文法来引导搜索。Nam 等人 （Nam 等人，2022）预测将输入转换为输出的 PyTorch 和 TensorFlow API 调用序列，以指导枚举式搜索。 在更粗的粒度上，AutoML-Zero（Real 等人，2020）从基本的数学操作演化出完整的机器学习算法；NEAR（Shah 等人，2020）和 dPADS（Cui 和 Zhu，2021）在 DSL 中搜索可微分的程序；而 Marinescu 等人 （Marinescu 等人，2021）则通过上下文无关文法来搜索机器学习流程。 这些技术是在预定义的搜索空间内合成简短的程序或流程，而智能体式的 MLE 系统则用通用语言编写端到端的解决方案；MLE-InsightForge 所整合的洞察在其中的作用类似于其学习到的先验知识，引导系统做出在相关任务中行之有效的决策。

paragraphs.en: Experience, memory, and context for LLM agents . Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) stores verbal feedback from earlier trials of the same task, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) extracts natural-language lessons from successful and failed trajectories and retrieves them for new tasks, and Agent Workflow Memory ( Wang et al., 2025 ) induces reusable workflows from past trajectories. ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) treats the agent’s context as an evolving playbook that is incrementally refined from execution feedback, and Agent Skills ( Anthropic, 2025 ) package instructions and resources that the agent loads on demand. These approaches mainly learn from the agent’s own trajectories. MLE-InsightForge instead assembles insights from human-written solutions and writeups of peer tasks, organizes them into domain, competition, and improvement insights, and compares the skill and playbook modes of injecting the same insights.

paragraphs.en: Mining Kaggle artifacts . DistilKaggle ( Mostafavi Ghahfarokhi et al., 2024 ) curates Kaggle notebooks together with code-quality measures, and Jin et al. ( Jin et al., 2026 ) mine Kaggle notebooks and use MLE-bench-style grading to study their reproducibility under modern execution environments. We use Kaggle descriptions, writeups, and top solutions as sources from which to assemble insights for solving unseen tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 挖掘 Kaggle 成果。DistilKaggle（Mostafavi Ghahfarokhi 等人，2024）对 Kaggle 笔记本进行了整理，并纳入了代码质量指标；而 Jin 等人（Jin 等人，2026）则挖掘了 Kaggle 笔记本，并使用 MLE-bench 风格的评分方法，研究这些笔记本在现代执行环境下的可重复性。我们利用 Kaggle 上的描述、说明文以及最佳解决方案作为来源，从中提炼出解决未知任务的见解。

paragraphs.en: Data contamination in benchmarks . Contamination of evaluation data threatens the validity of LLM benchmarks, and LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) mitigates it by continuously collecting problems released after the models’ training cutoffs. For agentic MLE systems, the relevant contamination also comes from insight sources available at solving time (§ 2.3 ); MLE-InsightBench controls these sources by construction, using only causal non-descendants of the target tasks as sources.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试中的数据污染。 评估数据的污染会威胁到大型语言模型（LLM）基准测试的有效性，而 LiveCodeBench（Jain 等人，2025）通过持续收集模型训练截止时间之后发布的问题来缓解这一问题。 对于智能体式最大似然估计（MLE）系统，相关的污染也来自解决问题时可获得的信息来源（§ 2.3）；MLE-InsightBench 在构建时就控制了这些来源，仅使用目标任务的因果非后代作为信息来源。

paragraphs.en: We studied how insights assembled from closely-related MLE tasks affect an agentic MLE system. We collected MLE-InsightBench , whose held-out split of 160 Kaggle competitions in 12 domains keeps target task information out of the insights, and designed MLE-InsightForge , an agent that assembles evidence-backed domain insights, competition insights, and improvement insights from the source competitions and injects them as skills or a playbook. The assembled insights improve the normalized private-test score by 123.9% as skills and 122.8% as a playbook; the three types of insights are complementary, skills are more cost-effective, and the improvements generalize. These findings suggest treating insight assembly as an explicit component of agentic MLE systems whose sources are controlled in evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了从密切相关的最优语言估计（MLE）任务中整合而来的见解，如何影响具备智能体能力的 MLE 系统。 我们收集了 MLE-InsightBench，其保留的测试集包含来自 12 个领域的 160 项 Kaggle 竞赛，且目标任务的信息不会出现在这些见解中；同时我们还设计了 MLE-InsightForge——一个智能体，它从源竞赛中整合有证据支持的领域见解、竞赛见解和改进见解，并将其作为技能或策略手册注入系统。 整合后的见解使归一化私有测试分数分别提升了 123.9%（作为技能）和 122.8%（作为策略手册）；这三类见解具有互补性，其中技能更具成本效益，且改进效果具备泛化能力。 这些发现表明，在评估过程中应将对见解的整合视为具备智能体能力的 MLE 系统的一个明确组成部分，并控制其信息来源。
